critic_inputs_permitted: the source of the single test under review
contract.default_is_keep: an unreadable reply, a REMOVE with no EXTRA line, a too-short justification, or a vague restatement all KEEP the test; only a named condition deletes it
contract.explicit_note: several examples of one stated requirement are not an extra condition; this is stated in the prompt because it is the distinction Gen62's critic collapsed
contract.guardrail_in_force: a bank retaining under 50% of its tests is HOLLOWED and inadmissible, so indiscriminate deletion cannot pass
contract.question: does requiring the critic to NAME the unsupported extra condition stop it deleting sound tests, while still removing the false ones?
contract.single_change_from_gen62: the critic prompt and its reader; a deletion is only honoured when accompanied by a named concrete extra condition
unchanged: the Gen61 generated banks, byte for byte

session: one stateless HTTP request per test; no conversation carried over
